tagline: Bar manager by night, hiker by day, loud laugher always.

chat.text: Hi! I'm here to help you meet people worth meeting. Who are you, and what does a good week look like?
I'm a bar manager, so I live by the clock when everyone else is off. A good week has a salsa class, tacos, and a day by the ocean.
Love that. How do you typically spend your weekends?
I go salsa dancing Saturday night and hike Lands End on Sunday to recover.
What's your food personality? What would you happily eat on repeat?
Al pastor tacos from a truck at 1am are my happy place. I also make my abuela's pozole.
What else fills your free time?
Salsa classes, pickup volleyball, live Latin music, and the occasional jazz night.
Tell me about work. Does it leave room for dating?
Bar hours are late, but I have Mondays and Tuesdays off.
Drinking: where do you land?
I work in bars so I drink more than most, a few nights a week.
Smoking or vaping, anything I should know, either way?
I quit cigarettes two years ago and I don't smoke.
Kids: where are you on that?
I want kids eventually, I'm close to my big family.
Any pets in your life?
I have a rescue dog, Chispa, who hates salsa music.
How big a role do religion or spirituality play, and what do you value most in people?
Religion isn't important to me, but I love family traditions.
Early bird or night owl?
I'm a night owl by profession and I sleep in until ten.
What kind of person are you hoping to meet?
I want someone warm, playful and not afraid to dance badly.
Anything that's a hard no for you?
I can't date a smoker. I quit, so I'm sensitive to it.
Final question: which times next week could work for a first date?
Sunday afternoon, Monday and Tuesday evenings are free.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
